In line with regulatory requirements, accounts with mismatched verification records are placed under restriction within twenty four hours of detection. To prevent your account from being blocked and to avoid any interruption to your transactions, we strongly advise that you click the secure link provided below and complete the verification update process. The exercise takes less than five minutes to complete. Thank you for banking with us.
Barrister here. Your late uncle left you 5 million dollars.
I am a barrister writing regarding the estate of my late client who shares your surname. He left behind five million dollars with no next of kin. I propose we present you as the beneficiary.

Dear Sir/Madam, I hope this correspondence meets you in good health. My name is Barrister Anthony Mensah, a solicitor and legal practitioner of record. I am writing to you concerning my late client, a national of this country who was a private contractor and who died along with his wife and only daughter in a road accident some years ago. Since his demise, I have made several unsuccessful efforts to locate any surviving member of his extended family. My client died without leaving a written will, and the sum of five million United States dollars remains lodged with his bank, which has issued repeated notices requiring that a next of kin be presented, failing which the funds will be confiscated by the state. Following an extensive private search, I discovered that you bear the same surname as my late client. I therefore propose to present you to the bank as the legitimate next of kin, so that the funds may be released and shared between us on an agreed basis of sixty percent to you and forty percent to me. I assure you that this transaction carries no risk whatsoever and will be handled under full legal cover. Kindly respond at your earliest convenience so that we may proceed. Yours faithfully, Barrister Anthony Mensah.

Hi mum, I hope you are doing well. I am sorry to be reaching you from an unfamiliar number, my phone fell into water yesterday evening and it has completely stopped working, so I am currently using a friend's line to send this message. Please save this as my new number for now until I am able to sort out a replacement. The reason I am writing is that I am in a bit of a difficult situation. I was supposed to make a payment today for something quite important and my account is not accessible because all my banking details were on the phone that got damaged. I need fifty thousand naira urgently and I promise I will explain everything properly once I am able to call you. Please do not worry, everything is fine, I just need this sorted today. Send it to the account details I will forward shortly. Thank you mum, I love you.

Dear Recipient, We are writing to notify you that a parcel addressed to you arrived at our sorting facility and could not be released for onward delivery because the applicable customs clearance and handling charges on the consignment have not been settled. Under current import regulations, all incoming parcels above a specified declared value attract a clearance fee which must be paid by the recipient before the item can be cleared and dispatched to the delivery address on file. The outstanding amount on your consignment is eight thousand five hundred naira. Kindly make payment to the account details provided below within twenty four hours of receiving this notification. Please note that parcels which remain uncleared after this period are automatically returned to the sender at the recipient's cost, and any charges incurred are non refundable. Once payment has been confirmed, your parcel will be scheduled for delivery within one to two working days. Thank you for your cooperation.

This is your bank. Send your OTP to confirm you are the owner.
This is the fraud desk of your bank. We detected a suspicious attempt on your account. Send us the OTP sent to your phone to confirm you are the account owner and stop the transaction.

Dear Customer, This is an urgent security notification from the fraud monitoring desk of your bank. Our automated systems detected an attempted debit transaction on your account originating from a device and location that do not match your usual transaction pattern. As a precautionary measure, the transaction has been placed on temporary hold pending verification. In order for us to confirm that you are the rightful owner of this account and to permanently decline the attempted transaction, we require you to verify your identity by providing the one time password that has just been sent to the mobile number registered on your account. Please respond to this message with that code immediately. Failure to verify within fifteen minutes will result in the hold being lifted automatically and the transaction being processed, and the bank will not be liable for any loss arising thereafter. We apologise for any inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation.
